question.prompt:
The graph shows the distribution of the number of children in the families of the students in Ms. Jordan’s English class. The median number of children in the family for this distribution is

[Figure 1](figures/1995_AMC_8_Q19_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
The median is the middle value when the family sizes are listed from smallest to largest. The bar heights show that the numbers of families with \(1,2,3,4,5\) children are respectively \(2,1,2,2,6\). Thus there are
\[
2+1+2+2+6=13
\]
observations, so the median is the seventh value, with six values on either side.

The families with at most three children occupy the first \(2+1+2=5\) positions. The two families with four children occupy positions six and seven. Therefore the median is \(\boxed{4}\) children, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
solutions.title: Find the middle observation
